title: tc-pixel-loader
description: A pixel-grid working indicator: dots lit in a pattern, a shimmering label and the time since the work started; a check or a cross when it ends.

label.description: What the work is, in a few words

pattern.description: How the dots move: a diagonal "wave", a lit dot that "drive"s a snake path, a seeded "dots" twinkle, or an "orbit" round the edge

state.description: "working" animates and counts; "done" settles into a check and stops the clock; "error" into a cross

started.description: When the work started, in epoch ms; by default when the loader connected (or went back to working)

now.description: The current time, in epoch ms – given, the loader keeps no clock of its own and shows the time up to it

size.description: "md" is the default; "sm" fits inside a chat bubble or a row

labels.description: Rename the words for how it ended, over the defaults
